text.İhtiyaç kredisine başvurmadan önce tutar: Before applying for a personal loan, check 7 things such as the amount, term, credit score, documents and your contractual rights to protect both your chances of approval and your budget.
text.İhtiyaç kredisi; beklenmedik bir harcama: A personal loan is an unsecured consumer loan that can be used for many purposes, such as an unexpected expense, education, home renovation or paying off debt. The application may take only a few minutes, but the small checks you make beforehand directly affect both your chances of approval and the total amount you will pay.
text.1. Gerçekten ihtiyacınız olan tutarı bel: 1. Decide on the amount you really need
text.Daha yüksek tutar daha fazla faiz demekt: A higher amount means more interest. Write down your needs item by item and think about which part you could cover with your savings. A larger amount can also shorten the longest term available to you.
text.2. Aylık taksidin bütçenize oranına bakı: 2. Look at the installment as a share of your budget
text.İhtiyaç kredilerinde kullanılabilecek en: The longest term available on personal loans is limited according to the loan amount under BDDK (Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency) regulations. The limits currently applied by the calculator on our site are as follows:
text.Vade uzadıkça taksit düşer ama toplam ma: A longer term lowers the installment but increases the total cost. Choosing the shortest term that doesn't strain your budget is usually the most economical option.
text.4. Kredi notunuzu önceden öğrenin: 4. Find out your credit score in advance
text.Bankalar çoğu başvuruyu dijital olarak d: Banks assess most applications digitally, but additional documents may be requested. It's useful to have these on hand:
text.Geçerli kimlik belgesi (T.C. kimlik kart: A valid identity document (Turkish ID card)
text.Gelir belgesi: maaş bordrosu, SGK hizmet: Proof of income: payslip, SGK (Social Security Institution) service record or, for retirees, pension information
text.Güncel adres bilgisi (e-Devlet'ten alına: Up-to-date address information (a certificate of residence, available from e-Devlet)
text.Serbest meslek sahipleri için vergi levh: For self-employed people, a tax certificate or income tax return
text.Kredi çıkarma vaadiyle sizden önceden üc: Don't trust anyone who asks you for an upfront fee, a file charge or your password in exchange for promising to get you a loan. Banks never ask for advance payment to approve a loan.
text.Tutarınızı ve vadenizi girin, bankaların: Enter your amount and term, and see banks' installments on a single screen.
text.İhtiyaç kredisi için kefil gerekir mi?: Do I need a guarantor for a personal loan?
text.Genellikle hayır. İhtiyaç kredisi çoğunl: Usually not. Personal loans are mostly granted without collateral based on your income and credit score; however, depending on its assessment, the bank may ask for additional collateral or a guarantor.
text.Başvurum reddedilirse ne yapmalıyım?: What should I do if my application is rejected?
text.Kredi notunuzu ve mevcut borç yükünüzü k: Check your credit score and current debt load, and try a lower amount or a different term. Avoid applying to many banks one after another in a short period.
text.Kredi sözleşmesinden vazgeçebilir miyim?: Can I withdraw from a loan agreement?
text.Evet. Tüketici kredisi sözleşmelerinde 1: Yes. With consumer loan agreements, you have the right to withdraw within 14 days without giving any reason.

html.Tüm kredi ve kart taksitlerinizin toplam: It's important that the total of all your loan and card installments stays within a reasonable portion of your monthly net income. Many financial experts recommend that this ratio not exceed one third of your income. After rent, bills and essential expenses, you should still have something left over for the unexpected.
html.Başvurmadan önce Findeks üzerinden notun: Before applying, check your score and credit report on Findeks. If you see a record that isn't yours or an incorrect late payment on the report, contact the relevant institution. For what you can do to raise your score, take a look at our credit score guide.
html.Aylık faiz oranı tek başına yanıltıcı ol: The monthly interest rate alone can be misleading. On personal loans, 15% KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund) and 15% BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax) are added to the interest; in addition, a processing fee of up to 0.5% (5 per thousand) of the loan amount may be charged. Compare offers with the same amount and term, based on total repayment and the annual cost rate. For a detailed example, see our article on loan costs.
html.<strong>Cayma hakkı:</strong> 6502 sayıl: Right of withdrawal: Under Consumer Protection Law No. 6502, you can withdraw from a consumer loan agreement within 14 days without giving any reason. In that case, you repay the principal you used and the interest for the period you used it within 30 days.
html.<strong>Erken ödeme:</strong> Kredinizi: Early repayment: You can repay your loan partially or in full before the end of its term. The bank is required to give you a discount on the interest and costs related to the amount repaid early.
html.<strong>Bilgi formu:</strong> Sözleşme ö: Information form: Before the contract, you must be given a form showing the total cost and the repayment schedule. Read it carefully before signing.
